task: Typography and transition reference review for application film
method: FFprobe metadata, 12 evenly spaced actual frames per clip, full-resolution inspection, constrained high-contrast text-pixel measurement. Original files are read only.
timing_precision: Stage times are approximate to sampled frame spacing; font identity and exact easing functions cannot be proven from raster video.

references.typography: Regular sans-serif, dark ink, centered three-line phrase, tight line spacing. Final text ink box x499 y411 to x1421 y663 at 1920x1080.
references.motion: Typewriter reveal with a thin vertical caret. Partial text remains centered and wraps to the next line as the phrase grows. First sample is black; background and partial first word visible at 0.25s; full phrase by about 2.5s. No bounce or decorative stroke.
references.background: Pale silver/blue frosted pillars, small corner radius, slow optical shimmer.
references.transfer: Use the typewriter/caret for the short opening question or transition sentence, then preserve a readable hold. Do not copy the reference's product claim.

references.typography: Large white regular sans-serif, single centered line; final ink box x445 y488 to x1472 y627, 53.5% frame width.
references.motion: Phrase resolves from strong blur to readable text through a selective moving focus region. Middle letters remain defocused around 0.95s; final phrase is sharp later. The phrase does not bounce or travel across the frame.
references.background: Near-black with cyan/teal soft vertical glows and grain.
references.transfer: For dark chapters use stable center-aligned text with a narrow progressive blur/focus sweep lasting about 1.1-1.3s, followed by a still readable hold.

references.typography: Dark regular sans-serif on light cyan/silver, one centered clause at a time. First clause's final ink box x284 y509 to x1634 y585, 70.3% frame width.
references.motion: Three sequential clauses replace one another. Each enters with a selective left-to-right blur resolving into sharp letters; observed changeovers near 2.1s and 3.65s. Clauses remain around the same center instead of entering from screen edges.
references.background: Broad horizontal cyan/white fluid bands with restrained drift and soft optical glow.
references.transfer: Use two short related clauses in longer opener/closer; for a four-second chapter use one clause with blur resolution and a long hold.

references.typography: White regular sans-serif, centered two-line text; first phrase ink box x496 y452 to x1409 y623. The second phrase is smaller because its card is farther away during transition.
references.motion: First statement deblurs quickly and holds until roughly 2s. Around 2.1-3.3s the entire background/text card tilts and recedes through multiple horizontally stacked perspective echoes. A new teal card rises to the front with a second statement; view is largely settled by about 3.9s. This is a whole-card transition, not a text-only slide.
references.background: Dark gray frosted pillars transitioning to dark teal pillars, with black negative space exposed by the stacked cards.
references.transfer: Reserve one whole-card stack transition for changing from analysis to hands-on production. Keep text short, preserve legible time before and after, and do not add camera bounce.

references.typography: White centered sentence, then brand line and short tagline. First phrase ink box x158 y492 to x1764 y608 (83.6% width). Final logo lockup is much smaller on black, with a tiny secondary line beneath.
references.motion: Opening background only, first phrase resolves by approximately 1.2s and holds through 2.4s. Brand phrase follows near 3.5-4.7s. Short tagline is typewritten with caret near 5.9s and holds around 7-8.3s. Cut to black logo animation near 9s; symbol resolves before the wordmark, then the subtitle appears around 10.5-11.8s.
references.background: Cyan/white fluid bands for statements, then clean black for final brand mark.
references.transfer: Use existing E-musician logo unchanged. Resolve name and repository address in a calm closing lockup with enough final hold to read. Reference supplies the staging pattern only; do not use its logo, tagline, or video pixels in delivered assets.

shared_design.alignment: Central alignment and stable optical center near y540 at 1080p; two/three-line blocks stay compact.
shared_design.type: Regular/light sans-serif, no bold headline styling, minimal tracking, generous surrounding negative space. Exact font unknown.
shared_design.color: Dark ink for pale backgrounds, near-white for dark teal backgrounds; no drop-shadow badge treatment.
shared_design.motion: Blur-to-focus, typewriter plus caret, or whole-card depth movement. Long text should not be flashed too quickly. Generic alpha fade alone does not match these references.
shared_design.suggested_four_second_chapter: 0.00-0.15s background; 0.15-1.25s focus/type reveal; 1.25-3.65s clear hold; final 0.35s optional blur/cut. Suggested timing is an adaptation, not a measured property of every reference.

reuse_boundary: Reference frames remain internal analysis evidence. Render final text on the project's existing original backgrounds; no reference pixels, logos, or audio are incorporated.
